# Field boundaries for Lithuania - Eurocrops 2021

Lithuania - Eurocrops 2021 field boundaries (2021) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Construction Sector Development Agency <https://www.geoportal.lt/geoportal/nacionaline-mokejimo-agentura-prie-zemes-ukio-ministerijos#savedSearchId={56542726-DC0B-461E-A32C-3E9A4A693E27}&collapsed=true>, EuroCrops. License: CC-BY-SA-4.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ec_lt/latest/ec_lt.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/ec_lt/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:4326; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: hcat:name_en, hcat:code, metrics:perimeter, id, geometry, claimant_id, metrics:area, crop:name, hcat:name, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ec_lt/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ec_lt/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ec_lt/collection.json
